name: WISPLC
full_name: Weakly Interacting Slender Particle detection with LC circuit
summary: A dedicated light-dark-matter instrument using pickup loops and LC resonant amplification.
detection_principle: Axions interacting with a solenoid's static field produce an alternating azimuthal magnetic field measured by a pickup coil, in broadband or resonant operation.

status.label: Under construction
status.evidence: 2021 sources support the phase recorded here, rather than a real-time status of the entire project as of the access date.

timeline.event: WISPLC: Search for Dark Matter with LC Circuit

collaboration.participants_note: Only documented principal institutions are listed; full author and affiliation lists are in the sources. Collaborating-institution addresses are not substituted for detector locations.

results.summary: A 2021 article describes full funding and construction; coupling sensitivity is a design projection.

science_scope: Directly searches for Galactic-halo axions, axionlike particles or other ultralight dark matter. Limits depend on assumed local density, velocity distribution and coupling models; separate scanned mass intervals do not amount to exclusion of the entire range.
